references.phrase: multiplication map S⊗_R S→S is ring isomorphism
references.context: Commutative algebra: multiplication morphism of the tensor-product R-algebra and an isomorphism of commutative rings

references.phrase: g∘f=h∘f implies g=h for all g,h
references.disposition: Cancellation is tested for all commutative target rings T and maps out of S, not ordinary surjectivity of f.

review_rationale: Reviewed the categorical cancellation test using post-composition with arbitrary g,h:S→T and the equivalent multiplication-map criterion on S⊗_R S; ring epimorphisms need not be set-surjective.
